title: MV RPG Maker MV tileset s sizes

posts.author: SnailLover
posts.body:
Hello, i'm trying to make a tileset that looks like the waterfall in undertale one, but i'm having issues with tilesets sizes, i think undertale uses a 20x20 tile size, while i know mv only supports 48x48, i've tried to follow
this plugin by Shaz
, but i get lost when it talks about resizing the original tilesets folder to 48x48, wich is already at that size
if anyone can help thanks in advance

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
what it means its, you use 20x20 tileset but paint the game in 48x48
as normal (upscaled version), when you playtest the game it uses
the 20x20 tileset.
I don't use the plugin, but you need both versions 20x20 and the 48x48
of the tileset in the same map.

posts.author: alice_gristle
posts.body:
Are you dead set on usin' 20x20 tiles? 'Cuz what you can easily do is make 24x24 tiles (close-ish to 20x20) and then simply upscale them 200%. That way you get MV's 48x48 tiles, but they gonna look like 24x24 tiles
Actually, now that I think about it, 20x20 maybe isn't all that close to 24x24... but you cud also try 16x16 tiles and upscale them 300%?
